reviews.text: This is ok, but I think I don't love it. I didn't find it particularly waterproof, but maybe it is better with different prep.ive switched to a brown liner that I like much better.
reviews.zh: OK 嘅，但我覺得我唔算好鍾意。冇覺得好防水，可能要配合唔同嘅妝前打底會好啲。我已經轉咗用一枝啡色眼綫，鍾意好多。

reviews.text: I have been using these for a while now and I love them. The fine tip is perfect for a sharp subtle line, but also great for creating a crisp dramatic wing. It's cry proof, I've tested it. 10/10 I will be buying these again.
reviews.zh: 我已經用咗一段時間，好鍾意。幼幼嘅筆尖最適合畫一條鋒利而自然嘅線，要畫一對凌厲搶眼嘅眼尾都好得。防淚水，我試過。10/10 我會再買。

reviews.text: The CLIO Sharp So Simple Pen Liner is incredibly precise and easy to use, even for beginners. Its fine tip creates clean, sharp lines effortlessly, while the formula stays put all day without smudging. Lightweight and comfortable to wear, it’s perfect for achieving a polished eyeliner look.
reviews.zh: CLIO Sharp So Simple Pen Liner 精準得嚟好用，初學者都用到。幼細嘅筆尖輕鬆畫出乾淨俐落嘅線條，配方全日都 keep 到唔化。輕身又舒服，想化出精緻眼綫妝容嘅必備。

reviews.text: I love the pencil version of this so I was excited to try the liner. It's not life changing or anything but it definitely stays in place all day (I have oily eyelids so usually my eyeliner slides off) and the colour is a really nice, rich brown.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢枝嘅鉛筆版，所以好期待試呢枝眼綫筆。唔係話會翻天覆地嘅改變，但係佢真係全日都貼服唔移位（我眼皮係油性嘅，平時眼綫會滑走），而且顏色係好靚嘅濃郁啡色。

reviews.text:
Easy to apply and draw the line. Despite it’s waterproof to an extend but it’s not oil proof so it gets a little blurry after three hours or so. Won’t smudge but if you rub your eyes by accident, it gets a little blurry. It’s easy to remove with makeup remover. 

The colour is very natural and soft. Would still recommend it and repurchase in future.
reviews.zh:
易畫易描線。雖然有防水效果，但唔抗油，所以大概三個鐘後就會有少少化。唔會甩色，但如果唔小心捽到眼，會有少少化。用卸妝產品好容易就卸到。

顏色好自然好柔和。我依然會推薦同埋回購。

reviews.text: I don't know if it's part of the formula that it doesn't paint much, but that's something I don't like. If you get the idea that it will leave you with a subtle outline, it can work perfectly for you. It has a nice color and you can handle it easily.
reviews.zh: 唔知係咪配方本身就畫唔到好多色，但呢一點我唔鍾意。如果你想要一條自然低調嘅輪廓，呢枝就啱你。顏色靚，好上手。

reviews.text:
When I first saw this eyeliner, I was a bit surprised because it was small and short! I thought the free gift was delivered. Haha.. I've never had an eyeliner smaller than my pen-
But I think I'll carry it around well because it's small!
reviews.zh:
第一次見到呢枝眼綫筆嘅時候有啲驚訝，因為佢好細好短！我以為係送嘅贈品。哈哈...我從來未用過細過我支筆嘅眼綫筆～
不過諗深一層，細細枝應該好方便隨身攜帶！

reviews.text: My new favourite eyeliner! I'm a beginner at eyeliner and have been struggling to get even a decent wing with the one I bought at the drugstore. The tip on this one makes it super easy. However, I noticed that a lot of the pigment is on the side of the pen rather than the tip. Not exactly waterproof like it said though, comes off with just a bit of rubbing. It is long lasting though! Definitely recommend for beginners.
reviews.zh: 我新嘅至愛眼綫筆！我係眼綫新手，之前用藥妝店買嗰枝連一對像樣嘅眼尾都畫唔到。呢枝個筆尖畫起上嚟超容易。但我發現好多色素都黐咗喺筆身側面，而唔係筆尖。但係都唔似佢講咁防水，捽少少就甩。不過都幾持久！新手絕對值得入手。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
